statement: For a countably infinite torsion-free group Q with exactly two conjugacy classes, every nontrivial quotient of Q^N/Q^(N) has cardinality continuum and explicitly surjects onto a nonprincipal ultrapower of Q. The reduced power is torsion-free, contains its diagonal Q, and contains Z^m for every positive m, hence has no finite-dimensional classifying CW model.
depends_on: A.21 supplies Q; explicit two-conjugate support factorization; maximal-ideal/ultrafilter extension; binary-prefix cardinal injection.
manuscript_pages_settled: R2 A3(iii): exact obstruction to quotient compression for a natural reduced-power family
notes: All normal subgroups of Q^N are classified by ideals of supports, with finite-union closure proved. Every quotient map factors explicitly to an ultrapower of cardinal continuum. The statement is restricted to the indicated two-conjugacy-class Q; it is not asserted for every choice of the finite-system-closed E in A.19.
